hero.headline: Create Regenerative Prosperity
hero.intro: Launch a business that serves the community and regenerates our ecosystem. Advance your impact through our {acronym} tiers.

economy.firstBody: Every business here agrees its revenue share with the village, business by business.
economy.secondBody: All {village} businesses are co-owned by the village community. You operate and manage your enterprise while the community shares in success through revenue participation.

steps.heading: Your Path to Prosperity
steps.intro: Follow these {count} steps to launch your regenerative business at {village}.

items.title: Attend Community Call
items.description: Learn about business opportunities at {village} and ask questions about our economic model.
items.bullet2: Learn how the village economy works

items.title: Explore the Prosperity Packet
items.description: Request the full guide to launching a business at {village}.

items.title: Submit Business Proposal
items.description: Present your vision and how it aligns with village needs and our regenerative mission. {guide}, our guide, can help you shape it.

items.title: Sign {commitment} / Formal Membership
items.description: Become an official member of the community.

items.title: Community Approval
items.description: Present your business to the Business & Finance Council for community consent.

items.title: Grow Your Impact
items.description: Advance through {acronym} tiers and scale your regenerative business.

tiers.heading: {acronym} Tiers: {framework}
tiers.intro: Measure and grow your impact through our {framework} framework. Advance through tiers based on community contribution and regenerative outcomes.

packet.heading: Ready to Explore Opportunities?
packet.body: Request the Prosperity Packet to learn everything about launching a business at {village}.

closing.heading: Launch Your Regenerative Business
closing.body: Start with a community call to ask questions about the economic model, then request the Prosperity Packet and begin your journey.
